examples.en: Tom is going to do that sometime.
I often receive letters from him.

examples.text: Talvolta dovremmo esporre i nostri corpi al sole.
examples.en: We should sometimes expose our bodies to the sun.

examples.text: La gente talvolta paragona la morte al sonno.
examples.en: People sometimes compare death to sleep.

examples.text: Le persone sposate talvolta desidererebbero essere single.
examples.en: Married people sometimes wish they were single.
